motion.method: Pre-motion frames: evidence/pre-motion-hashes.json (SHA-256 of the v3 frames before motion). The capture is byte-deterministic, so equal hashes mean identical pixels.

daily-ar-1440x900-hover.expectedToChange: Round 7: marker form B (the hollow ring) replaces the Round 6 reading sight; the value at the peak stop is unchanged (62)

daily-ar-1440x900-tuner-open.expectedToChange: Round 6: the tuner's Motion group; Round 7 step 2: its hover speed (the step-1 Marker group is gone); Round 7 step 3: the intro speed and Replay intro

spec.animates: nothing but the first-open intro: the surfaces, lights, labels, grid, axes and usual line are complete at first paint (no stagger, no rise, no light entrance)
spec.note: a reload or a return in the same tab has no intro; only the live pulse runs at rest, and only while live

spec.animates: transform translateY of each answer's numeric expression (Inside now, Today's peak, Entries, Busiest time), from below into the digits' ink box, clipped to it: the digit roll entering the final value; while delayed the stale Inside now number is still
spec.note: only on the first open in a tab; no count-up and no intermediate value; the DOM text is final from the first paint; nothing is announced

spec.animates: stroke-dasharray of today's line parts, drawn by minutes since open from opening to the latest reading (right to left in Arabic), and one clip uncovering the fine vertical lines to the same minute
spec.note: the missing span stays a gap throughout; the grid, axes and usual line are still from the first paint

spec.motion: First-open intro: the end point and the peak
spec.animates: SVG transform scale: the live end point and halo from the line tip's size (0.34) to 1, the peak ring from the same 0.34 to 1; the stale end point, the peak's drop and its label appear at once when the line arrives
spec.note: about 820 ms in all; it settles at once on any action, a new reading or a resize; the pulse starts when it ends
no entrance, no pointer-follow, no crowd-dependent light

spec.animates: transform translateY of the changed digits only, by the height of the digits' ink box (the new digit from below when rising, from above when falling; the old one leaves the other way), clipped to that ink box; the slot's width eases from the old digit's width to the new one's (Readex Pro has no tabular figures)
spec.note: no opacity on any glyph; words swap at once; plain markup restored at the end

spec.animates: transform scaleY (from the bottom) of a red fill in each bar that changes
spec.delayMs: 0, +50 per further bar (lower bars first when rising, upper first when falling)
spec.note: the level word swaps at once

spec.motion: Chart: the marker follows its stop (Round 7 step 2)
spec.animates: SVG geometry each frame along the drawn path (the ring B and its lit hairline, moved in place); the tooltip's left/top ride with it
spec.durationMs: about 400 ms to settle, whatever the distance
spec.easing: two first-order lags in series, tau 90 ms and 15 ms, divided by the hover speed (1)
spec.note: no restart: a new target keeps the position and velocity; at once (the marker) across the missing span, into the future, onto or off the gap stop, or more than 360 minutes away, while the tooltip eases into its new place; the tooltip's text changes at once and it appears and leaves at once

spec.motion: Live: new reading, tail morph and extension
spec.animates: SVG path d of the last ~15-30 minutes only, end point cx/cy, the tail's fine lines, the now clip

spec.motion: Live: end-point pulse (live state only; none while delayed)
spec.animates: a 1px ring: opacity 0.4 to 0, transform scale 0.34 to 1 (9.5px to 28px)
spec.note: infinite; the ring is visible for the first 48% of each 5 s cycle

spec.animates: end cap translateX (0 to 156px, inline-end), middle scaleX (0 to 1) from the inline-start, darker surface layers and shadow opacity 0 to 1 (no text); each name uncovered by a clip-path that follows the end cap
spec.note: the width switches at once and is never animated; names never fade

fontCache.note: every intro context serves the Google Fonts files from memory after their first network fetch (same bytes), as a browser cache does for a returning owner
